top_apps.name: Free Fire: Undersea Mystery
top_apps.description_short: Mysterious ocean energy has surged, and a latest undersea adventure begins.
top_apps.description_excerpt:
The Undersea Mystery has arrived!
Mysterious ocean energy has surged, and a undersea adventure begins.

[Undersea Realm]
Board a whale‑themed aircraft into the map! Enter the Undersea Realm in Bermuda through whirlpool entrances and fight underwater. The High-tier Loot Zone becomes the Hydro Zone, and giant whales fly across the sky to drop Bubble Airdrops.

[Hydro Blaster & Fishing Ponds]
Try the latest event weapon, the Hydro Blaster, for a fresh combat feel. Fishing ponds containing loot have been added to Battle Royale, offering updated rewards for exploration and combat.

[Ocean Watch]
Complete tasks to earn tokens, summon and observe sea creatures, and unlock the Sea Creatures Guide. Spot rare species to earn extra tokens!

[Upgraded Character - Ray]
Lock on and hunt. Ray can mark and track a target and knock them down when they are low on HP. Successful takedowns refresh his skill, making him a chained hunter on the field.

top_apps.name: No I’m Not a Human
top_apps.description_short: No I’m not a human horror game. Spot visitors, survive nights, trust no one.
top_apps.description_excerpt:
The sun has become a death sentence, and the world is ending. In No, I’m Not a Human Game, survival isn't just about finding shelter—it's about who you let share it with you. As a solar catastrophe scorches the earth, hostile entities known as "Visitors" have emerged. They look like us. They talk like us. But they are not us in this No I’m Not a Human.
TRUST IS A DEATH SENTENCE Every night, survivors will knock on your door begging for refuge. Your job is simple but terrifying: identify the humans and eliminate the monsters. One mistake is all it takes for the nightmare to begin inside your own walls.
CAN YOU SPOT THE SIGNS? In this not human horror experience, you must use every tool at your disposal to uncover the truth.
Interrogate Guests: Listen to their stories, but don't be fooled.
Search for Traits: Look for the physical glitches that prove i am not human.
Manage Your Paranoia: The "End of Times" atmosphere creates a psychological pressure where every shadow feels like a threat.
💀 WHY YOU’LL FEAR THE NIGHT
Horror: Experience the chilling "uncanny valley" effect where familiar faces become your worst enemies.

top_apps.name: TEKKEN 9 Game
top_apps.description_short: TEKKEN 9 delivers epic battles, stunning graphics, and legendary fighters!
top_apps.description_excerpt:
TEKKEN 9 is the next evolution of the legendary fighting game franchise, delivering an even more intense, visually stunning, and action-packed combat experience than ever before. Built with cutting-edge technology, TEKKEN 9 introduces breathtaking graphics, highly detailed character models, dynamic battle arenas, and spectacular visual effects that make every fight feel cinematic and immersive.

Continuing the epic saga of the Mishima bloodline, TEKKEN 9 takes players deeper into a world of rivalry, power, and revenge. The story follows the ongoing conflict between powerful fighters as new threats emerge and long-standing feuds reach their breaking point. Featuring dramatic storytelling, high-quality cutscenes, and unforgettable character moments, the game offers an engaging experience for both newcomers and longtime fans.

TEKKEN 9 features a massive roster of iconic fighters alongside exciting new characters, each with unique fighting styles, signature moves, and devastating combo attacks. Players can master a wide variety of martial arts disciplines, experiment with different strategies, and discover countless ways to dominate their opponents.
